parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of the fan blades made of wood, attached to the central hub of the ceiling fan.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation in the room.
parts.Movement_description: The blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the ceiling fan, made of metal, which houses the motor and connects to the ceiling mount.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan blades and motor, ensuring stability and proper rotation of the fan.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while supporting the rotating fan blades.
